integrity: A complete analytic argument and a reproducible exact-rational coefficient identity checker accompany the finding. Literature comparisons are preliminary and cannot establish global novelty or independence.
scientific_limitations: Real square-free quadratic polynomials on finite-dimensional supremum-norm spaces; exact constants established only for dimensions 2 through 6; lower bound but not exact higher-dimensional constants; equivalent formulation in unindexed literature remains possible.
title: Exact dimension-six onset for square-free quadratic polarization on \(\ell_\infty^n\)
